title: DataPraxis: Scaling Analytics Tasks via Verified Workspace Evolution
authors: Nan Jia, Wenxuan Shi, Jingqing Ruan, Zhizhao Zeng, Tianyi Zhai, Zhongda Su, Feng Hong, Zhengyu Chen, Wenhao Yan, Haojin Yang, Siqi Dai, Weipeng Zhang, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26924）：DataPraxis 的出发点是任务合成的证据问题——'generating tasks directly from raw data often overlooks deeper questions that emerge through analysis and provides limited evidence for verification'。方法是 verified workspace evolution：'progressively enriches workspaces with validated findings and artifacts, then inherits and combines these workspaces to uncover deeper questions'，再从累积结论及其依赖构造任务，'verifying analytical results both during evolution and after task assembly'。产出是 DataPraxis-5K（'a dataset of 5,000 verified trajectories spanning diverse domains and output formats'），训练出 DataPraxis-27B 与 DataPraxis-35B-A3B。分数为作者自述：'DataPraxis-27B achieves 55.11 on DABStep and 51.9 on JobBench, matching or surpassing frontier models such as GLM-5.2'。价值路由：今天 10 篇里它与 Navalia 构成同一条主线——'用可验证的自动任务合成喂长程 agent 训练'，而 DataPraxis 的差异点是验证发生在 workspace 演化过程中而非只在任务装配后。对我们的实际用法是 '已验证轨迹' 这个资产形态：不是题目集合，而是带依赖与可验证结果的轨迹。证据 / 数据集：abs 页给出 http://huggingface.co/datasets/stargazerhust/DataPraxis-5k ，但 huggingface.co 今日从本机实测不可达（curl 返回 HTTP 000，非 404），无法确认数据集是否已可下载及实际规模，标注待核验/暂无；DABStep 55.11 / JobBench 51.9 与 GLM-5.2 的对比口径（是否同 prompt / 同工具 / 同裁判）摘要未说明，无第三方复现。今日动作：纳入趋势雷达连续观察；跟踪是否出现开源训练代码与复现报告。
